title: Hair Transplant Technician
description: About the jobWe are looking for a hair transplant technician to join us at ZARC Hair Clinic in Malmö. This role combines meticulous, hands-on work with close contact with people. You will contribute to the treatment itself while helping each client feel safe, comfortable and well cared for.We believe you have an eye for detail, enjoy working in a team and bring a warm, welcoming approach. At our clinic, quality and care go hand in hand—from the first meeting to follow-up.About the roleAs a technician, you will take part in our hair transplant procedures and help ensure a positive experience for each client. Your responsibilities include preparing the client and treatment room, sorting, assessing and separating grafts during the procedure, and keeping the client comfortable and reassured throughout their treatment.During a hair transplant, hair follicles are moved from a donor area, usually at the back of the head, to areas where the client would like greater hair density, such as the temples or crown. The follicles are extracted and then implanted into the recipient area. The procedure is performed under local anaesthesia and typically takes 3–6 hours.The work requires attention to detail, excellent fine motor skills and the ability to stay focused for extended periods. You should enjoy practical, precise work and close teamwork. A calm, attentive manner, good hygiene practices and care for the client throughout the procedure are equally important.The role is based at our clinic in Varvsstaden, Malmö.About youYou have at least eight years of experience in hair transplantation. You are confident in the different stages of the procedure and enjoy precise work that requires fine motor skills, patience and concentration.You are meticulous, organised and responsible, with a desire to continue developing your skills with us. Ideally, you are looking for a long-term role where you can contribute both your expertise and your commitment.Above all, you have a warm and attentive approach. You take the time to listen, put people at ease and go the extra mile to make our clients feel well cared for.About ZARC Hair ClinicZARC Hair Clinic provides hair transplants and PRP treatments in Varvsstaden, Malmö. We are a dedicated team that values close collaboration, attention to detail and a warm, welcoming approach. Quality and care shape both how we look after our clients and how we work together. We aim to build a workplace where everyone feels involved, takes responsibility and has the opportunity to grow with the clinic.We look forward to meeting you!

title: Svetsare - 527782
description: At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what concerns people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we decarbonize and replace cars.  Welder for collision damage – your next challenge in Västerås!Are you a welder who thrives on challenges? Alstom is now looking for a new colleague who will work with repairs of damaged and crash-damaged vehicles in a dynamic and exciting environment. Your future roleYou will report to the Production Leader and work together with a dedicated and competent team.The group in the workshop consists of about 12 people and is a mix of both welders/blacksmiths and modification technicians (fitters). You will get good support and support from our colleagues from other functions such as engineering, industrialisation engineering, quality and purchasing.In this role, you will be an important part of the problem-solving process and we are looking for someone who has a passion for finding effective solutions. Your creativity and initiative are crucial to our daily work. The position includes, among other things:    Replacing and aligning body parts    Welding, gluing and riveting    Disassembling and assembling vehicles You will work with both black and stainless steel as well as aluminum. We don't expect you to have all the skills, but we believe that the following skills will help you succeed and grow in this role:     Relevant education or experience in welding    Previous work with welding and repair of vehicles or similar industries    Good knowledge of Black MAG (145 2-12mm) and Stainless Steel MAG (145 2-12mm) to ensure high quality and efficiency in the work    Knowledge of drawing reading and technical specifications related to welding    Worked with welding that has requirements for non-destructive testing, such as Visual Inspection, Penetrant or Magnetic Powder.    Be able to communicate freely in Swedish and good knowledge of English Qualifications:    Welding certificate    Post-Weld Direction    Alu MIG (141 2-12mm), TIG (141) and pin welding (131/111)    Heat direction/cold direction of bumps We value the following personal qualities in you:    Creativity: You have the ability to think outside the box, which helps us find new and innovative solutions to welding-related problems.    Solution-oriented: You quickly identify welding challenges and address them effectively, which is important for keeping our projects on track.    Collaboration-oriented: Your unpretentious approach lifts collaboration in the team and creates a positive work environment where we achieve common goals. The work is carried out during the day, but you should be open to being able to work shifts.This service requires you to undergo a medical examination, which Alstom will provide. Interviews take place on an ongoing basis, so send in your application today.  Things you'll likeJoin us on a lifelong transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, allowing you to grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career.     Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career that is free from boring daily routines.    Working with the latest safety standards for the railway industry    Contributing to innovative projects    Steer your career in any direction you want across functions and countries    Leverage our investment in your development, through award-winning learning    Samarbeta med tvärpedagogiska team och hjälpsamma kollegor    Stora möjligheter till utveckling   Du behöver inte vara ett tågentusiast för att lyckas med oss. Viktigt att noteraSom ett globalt företag är vi en arbetsgivare som främjar mångfald i de 70+ länder där vi verkar. Vi är engagerade i att skapa en inkluderande arbetsplats för alla.

title: Product Owner - Surface Fleet and Automation Solutions
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:   Do you want to help shape the next generation of automation solutions for the mining industry? As a Product Owner within Surface Automation, you will play a key role in translating product strategy and customer needs into clear priorities and tangible results together with our development teams.  Join Our Team   You will become part of Surface Software Engineering, where we develop advanced automation solutions for Epiroc’s surface products. Here, we work across teams, functions, and countries, bringing together diverse perspectives to create solutions that deliver real value to our customers.      Your Mission   As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for translating the agreed roadmap, Epics, and objectives into clear team goals and a prioritized backlog. You will represent customer and business value throughout the development process and help the team stay focused on what creates the greatest impact. In this role, you will:    Own and continuously prioritize the team’s backlog based on customer and business value.        Translate roadmaps, Epics, and objectives into clear priorities, scope, and team goals.           Balance new functionality with quality, technical debt, maintenance, security, and risk reduction.           Follow development progress and deliveries together with the team, ensuring up-to-date forecasts for Epics and features.             Validate outcomes, gather feedback early, and use insights to adjust priorities.           Coordinate priorities, dependencies, and releases together with other Product Owners and relevant stakeholders.     Your ProfileWe are looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer, business, and technology. Your strength lies in creating clarity around needs, value, and priorities. Experience with industrial automation, autonomous solutions, mining operations, or other safety-critical and complex products is considered an advantage.   Location and TravelThis position is based in Örebro, Sweden. Travel may be required when needed.      In addition to a culture characterized by growth and development combined with a healthy work-life balance, there are a few things that make us especially proud to work at Epiroc:       Global career opportunities.     Epiroc University for your ongoing professional development.     Community engagement.     A comprehensive benefits package, including flexible working hours and bonus programs.A Hybrid Workplace Life at Epiroc may include the opportunity for a hybrid workplace. The hybrid work model is available when the nature of the job allows it, based on your role, responsibilities, and individual circumstances.     Application and Contact Information We encourage you to submit your application through our career site as soon as possible, but no later than November 29, 2025.   We are committed to a thorough recruitment process that includes interviews, reference checks, and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity verification as well as drug and alcohol testing. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive, and you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.

title: Two PhD Students in Atmospheric science
description: Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.At the Department of Computer Science, Electrical, and Space Engineering, we are looking for two Ph.D. students in Planetary Science. At LTU, Planetary Science is formally part of the research subject Atmospheric Science. Both projects investigate planetary solid surfaces. The projects will be conducted at Luleå University’s Space Campus in Kiruna. Subject description Atmospheric science deals with research on the atmosphere of Earth and other planets by modelling along with development and use of instruments for remote sensing and in situ observations. Special focus is on the atmosphere's dynamical, chemical, and physical processes, as well as better weather and climate predictions. Project description Both PhD projects address the evolution of volatile-rich surfaces on planetary bodies. You will be welcomed into a supportive group of researchers in Luleå University of Technology’s Division of Space Technology, whose focus is on investigating physical properties and processes of solar system bodies using the laboratory experiments and spacecraft measurements. Project A addresses an enigmatic process without terrestrial equivalent: the formation of crusts on the martian surface. You will be tasked with reproducing a crust-like surface regolith in the laboratory under Martian conditions, measure its thermal and mechanical properties, attempt to derive mechanical properties from imagery and accelerometer data of past missions to Mars including InSight and rovers, and compare these. Your results will inform drilling and sample return missions to Mars and your findings may help mitigate the risk to ExoMars and other planetary exploration missions of the future and support projects on planetary mobility in science, education and engineering. Project B is, quite literally, even cooler: it will investigate the surfaces of the icy moons in the outer Solar System. The project will simulate volatile extrusion and ejection, precipitation, crust formation and surface evolution processes in cold vacuum environments. Using laboratory simulations and physical models, you will investigate the link between volatile deposition, surface morphology, and surface mechanical properties. You will compare your results to theoretical models and spacecraft imagery. Your results will help explain spacecraft observations and inform future space missions to the outer solar system. As in project A, the outcomes of this project are expected to be useful for future missions aiming to explore the surfaces of minor bodies in the outer solar system, such as Ceres, Enceladus and Europa. Duties As a PhD student you are expected to perform both experimental and theoretical work within your research studies. You will communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. Most of your working time will be devoted to your own research project, of which you are gradually expected to take ownership. In collaboration with your supervisors, you will engage in the following research activities: -laboratory experiments involving environmental simulations; -analytical modelling of experimental results; -analysis of remote sensing data and comparison with experimental results; -dissemination of results at international conferences and in scientific publications. In addition to learning and improving your skills while performing these tasks, you will conduct literature reviews and attend courses as part of your graduate education. Optionally, you may support teaching and other departmental duties, limited to a maximum of one year of the total period not exceeding five years. Qualifications We are looking for enthusiastic candidates with the ability to work independently. You must have a master’s degree or equivalent in (geo)physics, astronomy, space or planetary science, or a related subject. Good analytical skills with an affinity for experiments are desired. Ideally, you are an effective communicator and fluent in English. For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en Further information Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. title: HiveAI Engineering Manager
description: AI is changing not only what software we build, but how we build it. As our HiveAI Engineering Manager, you will lead the team at the centre of that shift. You will combine people leadership, strong engineering judgement and AI-assisted development to turn ideas into production-ready products faster.This is an opportunity to help shape both a product and the way of working around it. You will build and lead a small, high-trust development team where AI accelerates engineering without compromising quality, security or maintainability.About the roleAs Engineering Manager for HiveAI, you lead the people and shape how the team works and delivers. You will lead an international team with developers based across several Fellowmind countries, so building trust, alignment and a strong team culture across locations will be an important part of your leadership.You will work as a peer alongside our Product Manager and Chief Architect, each with a clear but closely connected area of ownership. The Product Manager drives the why and what. The Chief Architect sets the technical direction and guardrails. You lead the team and create the conditions for great engineering.The way we build matters. The HiveAI team works from problems and hypotheses, using AI to move quickly from idea to experiment and prototype. What proves valuable is then hardened into secure, scalable and maintainable software. You will help define what this way of working looks like in practice as the team grows.You will lead a team that brings together platform developers, who build and maintain HiveAI itself, and Frontier Fellows (Forward Deployed Engineers), who work close to our implementation teams and customers and bring what they learn and build back into the product. Your job is to bring these two perspectives together as one engineering team.What you will do:    Build and lead the team. Own hiring, 1:1s, development and performance conversations, and build a strong, high-trust engineering culture across a distributed international team.    Design the way we deliver. Drive fast build-and-learn cycles, remove impediments and favour working demos and clear ship, change or stop decisions.    Turn prototypes into products. Together with the Chief Architect, make sure promising experiments cross the line into production with the engineering quality they need.    Make AI a real engineering capability. Coach developers in prompting, coding agents, AI-assisted testing and code review, and continuously evolve how the team works with AI.    Protect engineering understanding. AI should make engineers faster and help them learn, not become a substitute for understanding the systems they build.    Keep the focus on outcomes. Build a team that makes good decisions about what to build, how to build it and when AI is, and is not, the right tool.Who are you?You are a people leader who still thinks like an engineer.You probably spent a significant part of your career as a software developer before moving into technical and people leadership. Today, you might be an Engineering Manager, Software Development Manager or a Tech Lead with people responsibility, ideally in a SaaS or software product company.You are comfortable when the destination is clearer than the route to get there. You coach and enable your team, make good decisions with incomplete information and know when a fast prototype is good enough to learn from, but not good enough to ship.We believe that you bring:    Extensive professional experience in software development, followed by at least 2–3 years of people leadership, either as an Engineering Manager or as a Tech Lead with direct people responsibility.    Hands-on experience using AI coding tools and agents, such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or similar, as part of real software development.    Strong engineering practices across CI/CD, automated testing, code review and secure development.    Experience from a SaaS or software product environment, where teams own what they build beyond the first release.    Experience leading distributed or international teams, with the ability to coach, communicate and build a strong team culture across locations, mainly through digital ways of working.    Experience with Azure and the Microsoft technology stack, which is highly valuable given HiveAI's technology landscape.    The ability to start from a problem statement and a hypothesis, and to shape the route to a solution together with the team as you learn.    Professional proficiency in English and the local language of the country in which you are applying: Swedish, Danish or Dutch.You do not need to be the person writing the most code in the team. What matters is your technical background. It gives you the credibility and judgement to coach great engineers and challenge decisions. It also lets you create an environment where they can move exceptionally fast without losing control of what they build.What is HiveAI?At Fellowmind, we're building HiveAI, a platform for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. It provides a secure and scalable foundation for enterprise AI and enables organisations to move beyond isolated experiments towards AI solutions that become part of how the business actually operates.At its core is the HiveAI Technology, built on Microsoft Azure, which provides the foundation for deploying, scaling and managing AI agents securely. Around it sits the HiveAI Agent Lifecycle, helping organisations develop, deploy, manage and continuously improve their AI agents over time.Why Fellowmind?You will join HiveAI at a stage where there is still plenty to shape. You will have real influence on how the team, the product and the way of working take form, with an international organisation and the Microsoft ecosystem behind you.Fellowmind combines deep industry knowledge and personal guidance with Microsoft cloud technology across ERP, cloud infrastructure, data & AI, CRM, intranet and Modern Workplace. We are an international organisation with more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe.Our culture is built around putting people at the heart of what we do. We value collaboration, personal responsibility, development and the freedom to find a sustainable balance between work and life.

title: AI-Driven HR Operations Specialist
description: About the roleImagine HR where efficient, trusted processes and AI go hand in hand: smooth onboarding, people data everyone can trust, and reliable AI answers to everyday questions about how we work. As our AI-Driven HR Operations Specialist, you make that happen. You design, document, and automate our core HR processes, and you put AI to work wherever it does the job better, so managers and employees across Tacton spend less time on admin and more time on what matters. You bring HR, IT, Security, and Compliance colleagues along and can explain trade-offs to senior stakeholders.• Good judgment with confidential employee data.• Fluent English. Swedish and Workday experience are a plus.Your first six months• Map how our HR processes and integrations work today.• Agree a roadmap with priorities and baseline measures.• Get at least two improvements live and measured.• Introduce a documentation standard that the HR team uses.Why join us• You build it from the ground up. This is a brand-new role with no playbook to inherit. The processes, standards, and AI solutions you create become how HR works at Tacton.• Your expertise matters from day one. Our HR team already uses AI and is eager to do more, but we need an expert to lead the way. You will raise the bar for all of us, and because the need is big, your work will be seen and truly appreciated.• Your impact reaches the whole company. Every process you simplify saves time and increases quality for employees and managers in every country we operate in.• You have room to move fast. You report to our CHRO, who sees her job as removing obstacles for you. You join an engaged HR team of six in Stockholm, Chicago, and Karlsruhe that loves trying new things.• You grow with a company on the move. Tacton develops every day and is expanding from a single product into a full platform, so the role grows as you grow.What to expect during the recruitment process• Screening call with Global Talent Acquisition Partner• First interview with our hiring manager• Personality and logical ability test• Second interview and peer meeting, which will include a case• Interview with senior management• Reference checks• Background checksWhat we offerAt Tacton, you'll develop your career in an organization that values teamwork and promotes individual growth. We offer a global and open environment, working with the latest technology to solve important and complex problems in the manufacturing industry.• Flexible hybrid setup: 3 days a week in the office.• 33 days of paid time off: 30 vacation days plus 3 extra to make sure you get the rest you deserve.• Premium occupational pension: Our pension plan goes beyond ITP1, with higher employer contributions depending on your age and salary level.• Generous wellness allowance: 5,000 SEK annually to support your health and wellbeing.• Private healthcare insurance: Skip the waiting lines and get quick access to private medical care, including specialist consultations and treatments.• Parental leave top-up: We top up your parental leave, so you receive up to 90% of your base salary for up to 6 months, helping you focus on your family without financial stress.• Weekly treats: Fika one week, breakfast the next, because good food brings people together.Promise what you can build. Build what you promised. For 26 years, Tacton has helped manufacturers of complex products around the world do exactly that. Now we’re taking configuration intelligence further than ever. Through Tacton’s Connected Suite, every configuration flows on one digital thread from product definition to the factory floor, and AI agents can promise only what can actually be built. Learn more at www.tacton.com.

title: Senior Program Specialist QRC (Remote)
description: Company description:Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that contribute to quality enhancement and cost efficiency within healthcare and life sciences. We employ more than 10,000 people, and have operations in more than 40 countries. Saving lives is the greatest job in the world. Everything we do, from architectural planning to the equipment, therapies and solutions aim to secure the safest and most reliable care. As a leading medtech company, we focus every talent and resource towards helping our customers save as many lives as possible.Job description:Job Overview This position leads strategic global Quality compliance, Regulatory & Medical Affairs (QcRM) programs and projects, providing governance, cross-functional coordination, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and performance reporting. The role also supports IT-enabled initiatives by aligning QcRM business needs with Group IT solutions and oversees KPI reporting on quality-system health. This is a fully remote position.   Job Responsibilities and Essential Duties      Leads a portfolio of strategic programs and projects in alignment with QcRM objectives, organizational priorities, and applicable quality, regulatory, and compliance requirements.     Partners with executive sponsors and business owners to develop business cases, define program scope, objectives, success measures, governance, and decision rights, and prioritize initiatives based on value, risk, urgency, and available capacity.     Establishes and facilitates program governance forums, ensuring effective decision-making, accountability, issue resolution, and alignment across sponsors, workstream leaders, and stakeholders.     Develops and maintains integrated program plans, roadmaps, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and dependency maps; works with functional leaders to resolve resource, sequencing, and priority conflicts.     Directs cross-functional program execution from initiation through closure, coordinating workstreams, deliverables, milestones, interdependencies, and handoffs to achieve agreed outcomes.     Identifies, assesses, and manages program risks, issues, assumptions, and changes; coordinates mitigation and recovery plans and escalates matters requiring leadership decisions.     Builds strong stakeholder alignment through clear communication, expectation management, and timely, audience-appropriate reports and presentations highlighting progress, performance, risks, financial status, and decisions required.     Establishes and monitors program and portfolio KPIs to evaluate delivery, quality, adoption, and benefits against approved plans and to inform corrective actions and continuous improvement.     Coordinates organizational change management, stakeholder readiness, communications, training, and transition to operational owners to support successful implementation and sustained adoption.     Tracks expected benefits with business owners, leads program closure and post-implementation reviews, and ensures lessons learned are captured and incorporated into future planning and delivery practices.     Develops, maintains, and continuously improves standardized program and project management methods, tools, templates, and controls; coaches teams on effective planning, execution, governance, and reporting practices.     Serves as a key liaison between QcRM leadership, business stakeholders, and Group IT for technology-enabled initiatives, translating business needs into clear requirements and aligning solution delivery with quality, compliance, and operational objectives.     Co-chairs the QcRM IT Business Alignment Meeting (BAM) and supports governance of IT-related project intake, prioritization, approval, delivery oversight, and escalation from initiation through completion.     Coordinates technology implementation activities, including business readiness, validation and compliance considerations, data and process dependencies, user acceptance, deployment planning, and transition to support teams.     Collects, validates, and reports KPI data for internal and external reports on quality-system health, including Quarterly and Annual Sustainability reports, the GET Quality Scorecard, and Ethics and Compliance Committee and others as needed.     Coordinates timely follow-up on inquiries regarding these reports and the health of GetQMS and the global Quality System; strengthens KPI reporting processes and data controls to improve robustness, consistency, and accuracy.      Minimum Requirements      Bachelor’s Degree in a scientific or technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.     A minimum of 5 years of experience in a regulated industry, preferably within Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and/or Compliance.     A minimum of 3 years of experience in program and project portfolio management    Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities      Self-motivated with strong project leadership skills with the ability to motivate others     Excellent communication skills including the ability to understand and convey technical concepts concisely and accurately     Effective at problem-solving and collaborating with other departments in a solution-oriented manner     Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite – MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.      Internal and External Contacts/Relationships      QcRM Leadership Team     Group IT     Global Process Caretakers     Functional Leads in BAs (ACT, SW, LS) and Global Sales (SSUs)     Site Management Representatives (MRs)     External IT vendors and consultants

title: Unit Head - Vehicle Service Information, Drivetrain & Maintenance
description: TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. title: Interns for mapping Africa needed - remote
description: I am looking for interns willing to work for free to map Africa's cadastral (land parcel) data, starting with Kenya.In exchange, you will gain valuable experience and access to knowledge from me and via the work you do.I have worked with/for Esri Sweden, Wipro/StockholmExergi (Sweden), Lantmäteriet (Sweden), Geomaps LTD (Kenya), Kenya's Ministry of Lands, Swedesrvey AB, and Accra Municipal Authority (Ghana).I run a platform called Shambamap (https://shambamap.org) that aims to provide Africa's cadastral data for free to reduce corruption, fraud, and encroachment in Africa's land and property sector.The data will be used by banks, credit information bureaus, the general public, international players, and other government agencies.You only need to be over 18 years old, a Windows or Ubuntu (GUI) desktop computer at home, install QGIS and PostgreSQL, and work 100% from home to digitise maps that are already georeferenced.Shambamap is pre-revenue hence there is no promise of any salary. corrective actions.    Work closely with the responsible MarCom lead to support timely asset delivery.Reporting and escalation    Provide clear, concise progress updates to the Head of MarCom.    Maintain visibility of outstanding actions, risks, issues and decisions required.    Escalate concerns early, explaining their likely impact and recommending next steps.    Ensure that decisions and changes are communicated to everyone affected.Event execution    Coordinate operational readiness ahead of the launch event.    Maintain the execution schedule, responsibilities and description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Fachperson Arbeitsagogik (80-90%)--- Fachperson Arbeitsagogik (80\-90%)==================================Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit sozialem und wirtschaftlichem Angebot, ausgerichtet auf Menschen, die in Folge einer psychischen Beeinträchtigung auf Begleitung und Unterstützung angewiesen sind. Wir bieten über 200 Plätze im Arbeits\- und Tagesgestaltungsbereich und 28 Wohnplätze an.Für unser Geschäftsfeld **Elektromontage** suchen wir per 1\. März 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung eine aufgestellte**Fachperson Arbeitsagogik (80\-90%)**--------------------------------------Gemeinsam mit Menschen mit psychischer Beeinträchtigung führen wir im Geschäftsfeld Elektromontage vielfältige und anspruchsvolle Kundenaufträge aus. Dazu gehören Elektro\- und Komplettmontagen, Lötarbeiten sowie Kabelkonfektionen. Mitarbeitenden mit IV\-Rente werden von einem kompetenten Fachteam begleitet und unter Berücksichtigung ihrer individuellen Ressourcen unterstützt. So bewältigen wir gemeinsam die anstehenden Aufgaben und schaffen Voraussetzungen für persönliche Entwicklung, Teilhabe und das Erreichen individueller Ziele.### Das sind Ihre Aufgaben* **Agogische Begleitung:** Im Team mit anderen Gruppenleitungen führen, unterstützen und begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende bedürfnisgerecht bei verschiedenen Verdrahtungsaufgaben. Sie begleiten Entwicklung teilhabeorientiert und gestalten eine wertschätzende und motivierende Arbeitsatmosphäre. Sie dokumentieren individuelle Entwicklungsprozesse und führen die entsprechenden Verlaufsdokumentationen.* **Wirtschaftliche Aufträge:** In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsfeldleitung stellen Sie die termin\- und qualitätsgerechte Ausführung der Kundenaufträge sicher und pflegen den Kontakt zur Kundschaft.* **Planung und Organisation:** Mit Ihrem technischen Verständnis unterstützen Sie den Einsatz produktionsunterstützender Hilfsmittel und gestalten effiziente, auf die Fähigkeiten der Mitarbeitenden abgestimmte Arbeitsabläufe.### Das sind Sie* **Fachkundig und erfahren:** Sie bringen neben einer abgeschlossenen Berufsausbildung und Berufserfahrung im Elektro\- oder Industriebereich vorzugsweise eine Ausbildung in Arbeitsagogik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit oder sind bereit, sich entsprechend weiterzubilden. Sie verfügen über Erfahrung in der Begleitung und Förderung von Menschen mit Beeinträchtigung.* **Empathisch:** Sie zeichnen sich durch eine hohe Sozialkompetenz, Teamfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Dienstleistungsverständnis aus.* **Zuverlässig und kooperativ**: Sie arbeiten selbständig, strukturiert und verantwortungsbewusst und verbinden technisches Fachwissen mit agogischem Geschick.### Darauf können Sie sich freuen* Ein abwechslungsreicher und sinnstiftender Arbeitsalltag in einem engagierten, fachkundigen und kollegialen Team.* Ein vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet, in dem Sie Ihre technischen und arbeitsagogischen Stärken gleichermassen einbringen können.* Eine spannende Verbindung zwischen wirtschaftlichen Anforderungen und sozialem Auftrag, bei der die individuellen Fähigkeiten und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten der Mitarbeitenden im Mittelpunkt stehen.* Ein hohes Mass an Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum in einer gut strukturierten Arbeitsumgebung.**Weitere Fragen?** , Leiter Elektromontage, beantwortet sie gerne unter .Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.![Verein Werkstätte Drahtzug]()* Verein Werkstätte Drahtzug  Drahtzugstrasse 72 \- 78  8032 Zürich*jid66e02b1jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

Flexible working hours, possibility of remote work, continuing education and good work\-life balance.Two\-year fixed\-term contract, renewable. **Profil souhaité*** You have a PhD in natural sciences, engineering or related discipline, in\-depth practical understanding of intellectual property, including prior\-art searches and patentability analyses, drafting initial patent claims and further development in collaboration with patent attorneys* Minimum 3\-5 years of experience in technology evaluation, licensing and technology transfer in academia, industry, a startup company or a patent law firm* You are proactive, analytical, independent and comfortable working with researchers, companies and legal specialists. title: Spezialist/in Finanzbuchhaltung – Einstieg in die ERP-Beratung als ABACUS Consultant
description:
**Gestalten Sie die Zukunft des Finanz- und Rechnungswesens aktiv mit.**   

Die Digitalisierung verändert das Finanz- und Rechnungswesen rasant. Prozesse werden automatisiert, ERP-Systeme entwickeln sich laufend weiter und Unternehmen benötigen zunehmend Fachpersonen, die nicht nur Zahlen verstehen, sondern auch wissen, wie moderne Lösungen sinnvoll eingesetzt werden.  

Wenn Sie heute als Finanzbuchhalter/in oder Leiter/in Finanz- und Rechnungswesen tätig sind und Ihre langjährige Praxiserfahrung künftig auf einer neuen Ebene einsetzen möchten, könnte dies genau der richtige nächste Schritt für Sie sein.  

Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes und ISO-zertifiziertes Softwareunternehmen mit rund 25 Mitarbeitenden und langjähriger Spezialisierung auf ERP-Lösungen von ABACUS. Dank hoher Beratungsqualität und einer nachhaltigen Kundenbetreuung gehört das Unternehmen zu den angesehenen Anbietern seiner Branche.  

Zur Verstärkung des bestehenden Teams suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Spezialist/in Finanzbuchhaltung

**Ihre Aufgaben**   
Nach einer sorgfältigen Einführung begleiten Sie Unternehmen bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung der ABACUS Finanzlösungen. Dabei profitieren Sie von Ihrem fundierten Praxiswissen aus dem Finanz- und Rechnungswesen.  

Zu Ihrem abwechslungsreichen Aufgabengebiet gehören unter anderem:

* Mitarbeit und selbständige Durchführung von Einführungsprojekten im Bereich Finanz- und Rechnungswesen
* Analyse bestehender Abläufe und Beratung der Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Prozesse
* Erarbeitung von praxistauglichen Lösungskonzepten innerhalb der ABACUS Software
* Durchführung von Anwenderschulungen vor Ort oder remote
* Unterstützung der Kunden bei fachlichen und systembezogenen Fragestellungen
* Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Lösungen



**Idealerweise bringen Sie Folgendes mit:**

* Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Finanzbuchhalter/in, Leiter/in Finanz- und Rechnungswesen oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion
* Bilanz- und Abschlusssicherheit
* Freude daran, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und Verbesserungen zu entwickeln
* Interesse an Digitalisierung und modernen ERP-Lösungen
* Freude am Austausch mit Kunden und an der Weitergabe Ihres Fachwissens
* Vernetzte Denkweise sowie ein gutes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis
* **Erfahrung mit ABACUS ist willkommen, jedoch keine Voraussetzung**. Entscheidend sind Ihre fachliche Kompetenz, Ihre Lernbereitschaft und Ihre Motivation, sich in eine zukunftsorientierte Aufgabe einzuarbeiten

**Freuen Sie sich auf:**

* Eine fundierte und strukturierte Einarbeitung in die ABACUS Software
* Abwechslungsreiche Projekte bei unterschiedlichsten Unternehmen
* Ein familiäres und kollegiales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
* Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen mit Vertrauensarbeitszeit
* Mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien
* Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und zeitgemässe Sozialleistungen
* Einen modernen Arbeitsplatz an zentraler Lage in Basel
* Laufende interne und externe Weiterbildungen

**Interessiert?**   
Wenn Sie Ihre Erfahrung aus dem Finanz- und Rechnungswesen künftig mit moderner ERP-Technologie verbinden und sich fachlich langfristig weiterentwickeln möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen. collaborateurs.Afin de compléter nos équipes, la **Fondation Soins Lausanne** recherche **de suite ou à convenir** plusieurs : Assistant social (H/F)======================                                             **Taux d'activité entre 50% et 100%**                                               **Contrat fixe à durée indéterminée**  Votre mission  * Evaluer les besoins du client du point de vue socio\-économique ainsi que son niveau d’indépendance pour la réalisation des activités administratives tout en se basant sur les ressources à disposition  * Rétablir des conditions qui permettent aux clients, leur entourage ou une tierce personne de gérer les activités administratives en toute indépendance  * Faire valoir les droits des clients auprès des assurances et aides sociales  * Contribuer activement au maintien à domicile des clients par des mesures spécifiques tout en tenant compte des besoins individuels avec une prise encharge personnalisée et en favorisant l’autonomie  * Faciliter les démarches en vue d'un accueil de jour ou d'un hébergement, temporaire ou de longue durée  * Stimuler et soutenir les clients et leurs proches en maintenant au maximum leur autonomie et leur qualité de vie en fonction de leurs capacités  * Collaborer activement aux activités des équipes interdisciplinaires avec un rôle propre vous permettant de valoriser votre métier d’assistant.e social.e comme partie prenante à part entière du système de santé    Votre profil et vos compétences* Bachelor en travail social avec orientation en service social (ou reconnaissance SECO)  * Expérience avérée de 2 ans dans le domaine médico\-social  * Intérêt marqué pour la santé communautaire  * Capacité à collaborer en réseau et en pluridisciplinarité  * Sens des responsabilités, capacité à s'organiser de manière autonome et à fixer des priorités    Nous offrons* Un cadre de travail stimulant et chaleureux où l'autonomie du soignant est mise en avant  * Un environnement de travail qui privilégie le contact humain et l'échange  * Un travail passionnant dans un cadre agréable pour le bien\-être des clients  * Des conditions de travail et de rémunération équitables  * Des conditions de prévoyance professionnelle qui s’étendent au\-delà des prestations minimales prévues par la loi    Les avantages de nous rejoindre* Plan d’intégration par métier, offres de formations continues riches et variées, possibilités d’évolution professionnelle  * L'équité salariale entre femmes et hommes (certification Fair\-ON\-Pay)  * Rémunération selon la Convention Collective de Travail (CCT) du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois  * Offres avantageuses avec tarifs préférentiels dans des sociétés de services autour du sport, santé et bien\-être et loisirs divers  * Politique de mobilité douce et participation aux frais de transports publics  * Cinq semaines de vacances par année et six semaines dès 50 ans   Pour un traitement de qualité de votre candidature, nous vous prions d'adresser un dossier de candidature complet via Jobup jusqu'au **1 décembre 2026**, **en précisant le taux d'activité title: Consultant junior en recrutement IT - H/F
description: Membre du groupe Sigmalis, actif depuis 2007 dans le conseil et l’ingénierie en informatique, Sigmalis Talent Services accompagne les entreprises dans l’identification et l’attraction d'experts IT et de cadres, en proposant une offre complète en recrutement: placement fixe, délégation en régie, mission temporaire et executive search.Notre expertise en recrutement depuis plus de 20 ans en Suisse Romande, associée à une compréhension approfondie des métiers technologiques et des enjeux RH, nous permet de vous proposer des opportunités pertinentes dans des environnements professionnels réellement adaptés à vos attentes. Notre priorité est d’assurer votre réussite sur le long terme, que vous soyez en recherche d’un poste fixe chez un client ou comme consultant au sein de notre équipe.Description du posteVous souhaitez exercer le métier de recruteur dans un environnement où la technologie, la qualité de la relation humaine et la connaissance du marché sont au cœur du métier ?Rejoignez **Sigmalis Talent Services** et participez au développement d’un groupe suisse à taille humaine, spécialisé dans les métiers de l’informatique.**Le groupe Sigmalis**Présent en Suisse romande depuis 2007, **Sigmalis** ESN basée à Genève, accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets informatiques grâce à ses expertises en développement applicatif, Business Intelligence et Data Management. Ses consultants interviennent aussi bien en consulting que dans le cadre de projets réalisés au forfait.**Sigmalis Talent Services**, société sœur spécialisée dans le recrutement IT, accompagne les entreprises dans la recherche et la sélection de profils informatiques, dans le cadre de recrutements fixes ou de missions temporaires.Cette complémentarité nous permet de conjuguer connaissance des métiers IT, expertise du recrutement et proximité avec le marché suisse romand.**Votre mission**Vous prenez en charge l'ensemble du processus de recrutement, depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu'au suivi des candidats.Vous intervenez aussi bien sur les recrutements destinés à renforcer les équipes de consultants du groupe que sur les mandats confiés à Sigmalis Talent Services par ses clients.Votre rôle ne consiste pas uniquement à identifier des CV : vous cherchez à comprendre les parcours, les compétences techniques, les motivations et les aspirations professionnelles afin de créer des mises en relation pertinentes et durables.**Vos principales responsabilités*** Comprendre les besoins récurrents en recrutement, les environnements techniques et les profils recherchés,* Définir et déployer les stratégies de sourcing et d'approche directe les plus adaptées,* Rédiger et publier des offres d'emploi attractives et ciblées,* Identifier et approcher des candidats via les différents outils, réseaux professionnels et techniques de chasse de tête,* Analyser les candidatures et évaluer leur adéquation avec les exigences techniques, professionnelles et humaines du poste,* Préparer et conduire des entretiens approfondis et structurés,* Rédiger des comptes rendus d'entretien détaillés,* Accompagner les candidats tout au long du processus et assurer un suivi régulier et professionnel,* Garantir la qualité et la mise à jour des informations dans notre ATS et constituer des viviers de talents sur les profils régulièrement recherchés par notre groupe,* Développer une relation de proximité avec les équipes internes du groupe et comprendre leurs besoins actuels et futurs,* Contribuer à l'attractivité de nos opportunités et à notre marque employeur.Profil recherché* Vous disposez **1 à 3 ans d'expérience dans le recrutement de profils IT au sein d'une agence de recrutement ou d'une société de services informatiques, idéalement en Suisse romande**.Vous disposez également des compétences et qualités suivantes :* Excellente maîtrise des méthodes de sourcing, de recherche directe et de chasse de tête,* Bonne connaissance des principaux métiers et technologies informatiques,* Capacité à conduire des entretiens structurés et à évaluer une candidature au\-delà des seuls éléments du CV,* De langue maternelle française ou niveau équivalent, avec d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et un bon niveau d'anglais vous permettant de conduire des entretiens avec des candidats anglophones,* Sens de l'organisation, rigueur et capacité à gérer plusieurs recrutements et priorités simultanément,* Excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens de la communication,* Autonomie, proactivité et orientation résultats,* Goût du travail en équipe et capacité à collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs et métier j4id10481363jm j4it1147jm j4iy26jm

title: Banking Sector Coordinator & Key Account Manager - FS Markets
description: Banking Sector Coordinator \& Key Account Manager \- FS Markets Banking Sector Coordinator \& Key Account Manager \- FS Markets===============================================================**Discover KPMG – Become part of our team**  With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose\-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.Banking Sector Coordinator \& Key Account Manager \- FS Markets===============================================================**Location:** Zurich  **Workload:** 100%  **Start Date:** As soon as possible* Sector \& Account Support: Support the Banking Sector Executive and priority account teams in delivering sector and account priorities, coordinating activities and ensuring effective follow\-through.* Pipeline \& Performance: Maintain an overview of Banking pipeline, revenue and key opportunities, prepare regular reporting and highlight relevant insights and developments.* Go\-to\-Market Content \& Enablement: Support the development of Banking propositions, materials and sector content, helping account teams translate priority topics into relevant client conversations.* Go\-to\-Market Execution: Coordinate Banking campaigns, events and market initiatives, working closely with business, Marketing and Markets teams to ensure focused execution.* Market \& Client Insights: Monitor Banking market developments, regulatory topics and client trends, translating these into relevant insights for sector and account teams.* Knowledge \& Community: Support communication and knowledge sharing across the Banking community, ensuring relevant sector, market and account information is easily accessible.* Account Management: Provide hands\-on account management for selected priority Banking accounts, supporting account planning, client meeting preparation and follow\-up, internal coordination and go\-to\-market activities.* Client Analysis \& Relationship Mapping: Prepare client and relationship analyses to help account teams understand existing relationships, identify gaps and prioritize areas for further development.**Your contribution to KPMG****This is what makes you successful*** University degree in business or a comparable field of study; fluent in English, and/or French would be a strong advantage* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience in Financial Services or Banking, with a background in Markets, account management, business development support, consulting, or a similar role.* understanding of the Banking sector and an interest in market, regulatory and client developments.* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the confidence to coordinate effectively with senior stakeholders, account teams and multidisciplinary teams.* Proactive and hands\-on, taking ownership of activities and driving them through to completion.* Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work with pipeline, revenue and account data and translate information into clear insights and high quality presentation materials* Interest in AI and practical knowledge of using AI tools to support research, analysis and day\-to\-day work.* Comfortably operating in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities and a high level of interaction across the organization.**Your benefits**  **Unlock Your Potential**  We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future\-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open\-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.  **Mentoring and Networking**  At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.  From programs such as WoMentoring for early\-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.**Flexible Working**  With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.  **Additional Benefits**  Successful employees need top\-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility\-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half\-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.**Generous Parental Leave**  We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.  To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.**Inspired by Innovation**  At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies\-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting\-edge tools and state\-of\-the\-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.**An inclusive culture**  Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW , Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like\-minded colleagues.  **Questions? We're here for you**    Experienced Hire Recruiter  ![KPMG]()jidf40cd67jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: Collaborateur·trice admissions et support soins et accompagnement
description: **Depuis plus de 60 ans, la Fondation Claire Magnin prend soin de celles et ceux qui en ont besoin.** Au sein de ses 7 établissements (EMS et EPSM), 400 collaboratrices et collaborateurs s’engagent chaque jour avec exigence et sincérité auprès de personnes en situation de vulnérabilité.Ici, on questionne, on expérimente et on ose faire évoluer les pratiques pour s’améliorer en permanence. Nous en sommes convaincu·es : les compétences sont essentielles, mais ce sont avant tout les personnalités et l’engagement qui font la différence.Rejoindre la Fondation Claire Magnin, c’est faire le choix d’un environnement où l’humain est réellement au centre, porté par une équipe soudée et souriante, dans l’une des plus belles régions de Suisse romande.Si cela résonne en vous, alors rencontrons\-nous !Une équipe de haut vol !L’établissement des Hirondelles à Clarens réunit, sous un même toit, plusieurs approches complémentaires au service de ses 91 résidentes et résidents : santé mentale des seniors (SMS), psychiatrie de l’âge avancé (PAA) et Centre d’accueil temporaire (CAT).Ici, vous rejoignez une équipe interdisciplinaire soudée, où entraide et collaboration font réellement la différence au quotidien.**C’est le moment de passer à un métier qui compte vraiment !**Nous recherchons un·e **Collaborateur·trice admissions et support soins et accompagnement****Activités administratives*** Vous assurez la gestion et la coordination des admissions des résidents en long séjour, court séjour et en centre d’accueil temporaire (CAT), en veillant au suivi administratif, à la coordination avec les différents intervenants et à la bonne préparation de l’accueil du résident.* Vous assurez la réception, le tri, le traitement et la distribution du courrier interne et externe du département administratif et finances.* Vous assurez, en collaboration avec les autres collaborateurs du département administratif et finances, la gestion de la centrale téléphonique du département.**Activités support soins et accompagnement*** Vous évaluer les soins requis des résidents selon les critères OPAS et déterminez la classe de soins correspondante (1 à 12\) à des fins de title: Portfolio Manager
employer: Brevan Howard Investment Products Limited, Saint-Hélier (Jersey), succursale de Genève
description: The Portfolio Manager is allocated a defined amount of Master Fund trading capital and is individually accountable for the profit and loss generated on it. The role holder owns the complete investment process, from research and idea generation through portfolio construction, execution, risk management and performance attribution. The specific markets and style vary by individual; the expectations below apply to every Portfolio Manager in the Master Fund. It is a principal risk\-taking position, not an analytical, advisory or support function: the Portfolio Manager makes the final investment decisions and bears direct responsibility for their outcome.**Investment Management*** Generate profits for the clients of the Brevan Howard Master Fund by trading the allocated capital on their behalf, within the pre\-agreed trading mandate.* Originate, research and develop macro investment ideas, building each thesis on fundamental, quantitative and technical analysis, with particular attention to central bank policy, growth and inflation dynamics and their transmission into global rates, FX, inflation, volatility and equity index markets.* Construct a portfolio sized to conviction, liquidity and correlation, selecting the instruments and structures (cash securities, futures, swaps, options and other OTC derivatives) that give the most asymmetric expression of each view.* Deploy capital through directional and relative value expressions as the market regime warrants, including balance\-sheet\-intensive trades where the opportunity justifies it. Flexibility of style and the ability to scale risk into a strong theme are expected of a Master Fund Portfolio Manager.* Regularly reassess that the portfolio reflects the intended market view, and restructure or exit positions when a thesis is invalidated.* Take hands\-on responsibility for execution, counterparty relationships and liquidity sourcing, and ensure that any execution delegated to a trade analyst or execution trader is correctly implemented.**Risk Management*** Operate at all times within the risk framework agreed with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management: capital allocation, VaR and stress limits, leverage and balance\-sheet limits, concentration and liquidity constraints, and the fund’s drawdown limits.* Manage live portfolio risk daily and intraday, for the role holder’s own book and for any allocation run by team members, actively managing drawdowns and demonstrating strict discipline in loss management.* Liaise with the risk management team who deliver risk reports, articulating positions, rationale and sensitivities clearly and responding to challenge.* Liaise with Treasury to ensure positions are properly funded and that collateral is placed effectively.* Improve and scale risk\-taking over time as the investment process is proven, in agreement with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management.**Performance, Monitoring and Reporting*** Monitor, attribute and explain daily, monthly and annual P\&L and risk, and articulate performance drivers clearly to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and senior management.* Deliver a return commensurate with the capital allocated, at a quality of returns (information ratio, drawdown profile, consistency across market regimes) consistent with the Master Fund’s expectations.* Prepare periodic performance reports on a timely basis, monitor adherence to exchange and counterparty limits, ensure that all trading activity is appropriately allocated and accounted for, and maintain accurate records of the investment rationale for positions and decisions.**Contribution to the Fund and the Firm*** Contribute to the Master Fund’s investment dialogue, sharing views, data and expertise with the Chief Investment Officer, other Portfolio Managers and senior management in a collaborative manner.* Where leading a team, take full responsibility for the hiring, development, output and conduct of analysts, traders and sub\-portfolio managers, and maintain an ongoing commitment to their development.* Present periodically to the investment management committee and, where required, support the Client Partnership Group with current and prospective investors.**Governance, Compliance and Conduct**Operate at all times within the firm’s compliance policies, applicable regulatory requirements (including market abuse, conflicts of interest, best execution and personal account dealing rules) and the firm’s Code of Conduct; hold any regulatory certification the role requires in the relevant jurisdiction (for example the FCA Certification Regime in the UK); and act with integrity at all times.**WORK EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND:**Essential* A minim title: Physiothérapeute   en Cabinet Poste fixe à 80-100%
description: Ref 2591303 \| Date: 16 Nov 2026![Medicalis SA]( )MEDICALIS est le spécialiste du recrutement et de la sélection des talents actifs dans le secteur de la santé et du social, pour des postes fixes comme pour des missions temporaires. MEDICALIS est le partenaire privilégié d'hôpitaux, de cliniques, d'EMS, de CMS, de foyers spécialisés, de services de soins à domicile ainsi que de centres et cabinets médicaux, avec une présence dans toute la Suisse.Physiothérapeute H/F en Cabinet Poste fixe à 80\-100%=======================================================Description du client---------------------Vous êtes **physiothérapeute** et vous recherchez un **poste fixe à 80\-100%** sur le **Canton de Neuchâtel** ?Notre client, un cabinet recherche un profil de:PHYSIOTHERAPEUTE en Fixe à 80\-100%------------------------------------### Prise de poste à convenir !!!Description du poste--------------------Nous recherchons, pour le compte de notre client, un(e) physiothérapeute souhaitant s'investir durablement au sein d'un cabinet reconnu du canton de Neuchâtel, dans le cadre d'un poste fixe à 80\-100%.  Vous intégrerez une structure à taille humaine, composée de 3 physiothérapeutes et d'une secrétaire, offrant un environnement de travail moderne, organisé et stimulant, en plein centre\-ville et facilement accessible.  Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous assurerez une prise en charge complète et personnalisée de votre patientèle, en développant des traitements adaptés aux besoins cliniques et aux objectifs de rééducation de chaque patient. Vous interviendrez auprès d'une patientèle variée, notamment dans les domaines suivants : post\-opératoire, physiothérapie du dos, neurologie, uro\-gynécologie, drainage lymphatique et rééducation fonctionnelle.  Vos responsabilités comprendront notamment :  \- L'évaluation initiale des patients, la collecte des informations cliniques et l'élaboration de bilans précis afin de définir des objectifs de traitement cohérents et réalistes.  \- La mise en place et l'adaptation des séances de physiothérapie en fonction de l'évolution de l'état de santé, des prescriptions médicales et des besoins spécifiques de chaque patient.  \- La réalisation de soins en cabinet dans des salles de traitement fermées, au sein d'un plateau technique de plus de 400 m2 équipé de matériel moderne et de dernière génération.  \- La participation aux prises en charge en fitness médicalisé, avec suivi des exercices, correction des gestes et progression du programme de rééducation.  \- La prise en charge de patients à domicile lorsque la situation le nécessite, dans le respect des protocoles de soin et avec une excellente capacité d'autonomie sur le terrain.  \- La traçabilité des soins, la tenue rigoureuse des dossiers patients et la transmission des informations utiles à l'équipe et, si nécessaire, aux partenaires médicaux.  \- La contribution active au bon fonctionnement du centre, en collaborant étroitement avec vos collègues et la secrétaire afin d'assurer une organisation fluide des rendez\-vous et des suivis.  \- Le maintien d'un haut niveau de qualité dans la relation thérapeutique, avec une attention constante portée à l'écoute, à la confidentialité et à l'expérience patient.  \- La participation aux échanges d'équipe, au partage d'expérience et à l'amélioration continue des pratiques du cabinet.  \- L'investissement dans votre développement professionnel grâce à l'ouverture aux formations continues proposées par la structure.  Le poste offre un cadre de travail agréable, une flexibilité dans l'organisation du temps de travail ainsi qu'un environnement propice à l'exercice d'une physiothérapie de qualité, centrée sur le patient et la collaboration interprofessionnelle.Profil recherché-----------------Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bachelor HES en physiothérapie ou d'un titre jugé équivalent, reconnu obligatoirement par la Croix\-Rouge suisse.  Vous disposez d'une expérience dans la prise en charge physiothérapeutique et maîtrisez les techniques liées aux spécialités du poste, notamment la rééducation post\-opératoire, les pathologies du rachis, les prises en charge neurologiques, l'uro\-gynécologie, le drainage lymphatique et la réadaptation fonctionnelle. Une bonne maîtrise des protocoles de traitement, de l'évaluation clinique et de l'adaptation thérapeutique est indispensable.  Au\-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous vous distinguez par les qualités suivantes :  \- Un réel sens des responsabilités et une grande rigueur dans l'exécution de vos traitements et dans le suivi administratif de vos patients.  \- Une excellente autonomie, vous permettant de gérer efficacement vos consultations, vos priorités et vos éventuelles interventions à domicile.  \- Une forte capacité d'organisation et d'adaptation, essentielle dans un environnement dynamique et auprès d'une patientèle variée.  \- Une attitude motivée, impliquée et orientée qualité, avec le souci constant d'offrir une prise en charge professionnelle et bienveillante.  \- De bonnes aptitudes relationnelles, un sens de l'écoute développé et une communication claire et rassurante avec les patients comme avec l'équipe.  \- Une approche flexible du travail, ainsi qu'une capacité à collaborer harmonieusement dans un cadre pluridisciplinaire.  \- Une posture discrète, empathique et respectueuse, en phase avec les exigences d'un accompagnement thérapeutique de confiance.  Votre intérêt pour la formation continue, votre professionnalisme et votre engagement dans la qualité des soins seront des atouts essentiels pour réussir dans cette fonction.jpida1942b3jm jpit1147jm jpiy26jm

title: Global Account Senior Manager 100%
description:
**Location:** Zurich
**Workload:** 100%
**Start Date:** As soon as possible

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Understanding both the client's business agenda and KPMG services to enable leveraging the global KPMG network to connect our clients to the right people, ensuring that client needs are correctly identified, and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating global activities and knowledge transfer to ensure client needs are correctly identified and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating a global team of professionals and supporting their client interaction
* Closely collaborate with Global Client operations in Switzerland, US, UK, and APAC, ensuring that locations are actively engaged
* Guiding internal teams during the proposal, engagement contracting and onboarding process
* Managing selected client relationships with stakeholders (procurement, contracting, staff vetting, client resource needs, etc.)
* Manage KPMG Risk Management activities related to client and engagement acceptance
* Responsible for client and ad-hoc reporting, Annual Global account planning, Client service team planning and preparing for client meetings
* Ensuring regular reporting and marketing activities tailored to the needs of the relevant client stakeholders and keeping all internal key stakeholders updated with developments
* Organize client insights program / client-service reviews
* Influence without direct authority, frequently providing coaching and input to a high level of firm leadership



**This is what makes you successful**



* University degree at Bachelor's or Master's level in business administration, finance, economics or a related discipline.
* At least 6--8 years of relevant experience, including a minimum of three years in global account management, business development or complex programme management within Financial Services or professional services.
* Demonstrated experience managing a large, complex international client account, coordinating stakeholders and client-service teams across multiple countries, service lines and seniority levels.
* Proven track record supporting the full opportunity lifecycle, including account planning, pipeline management, proposal coordination, commercial development, contracting and client onboarding.
* Strong understanding of the Financial Services sector and the ability to translate a client's strategic priorities into concrete opportunities across a broad professional-services portfolio.
* Credibility and confidence working directly with senior executives, partners, procurement and risk stakeholders, with the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
* Exceptional programme-management discipline, with evidence of independently managing multiple concurrent workstreams, deadlines, governance requirements and executive-level deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal English, including the ability to prepare high-quality executive presentations and client communications; Proficient German is an advantage
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel



**Your benefits**

**Unlock Your Potential**

We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.
[Grow at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/grow-at-kpmg.html)



**Mentoring and Networking**

At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.
From programs such as WoMentoring for early-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.
[Work at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/work-at-kpmg.html)



**Additional Benefits**

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**

We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**

At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting-edge tools and state-of-the-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.

**Questions? We're here for you**

Vous définissez avec les clients les solutions les plus adaptées à leurs situations et développez ainsi une connaissance fine et une relation de confiance privilégiée avec eux. Faisant partie d’une équipe soudée et soutenante, l’exercice de ces métiers permet une grande autonomie mais nécessite de grandes responsabilités et une flexibilité de la part de nos collaborateurs.Afin de compléter nos équipes, les CMS de la **Fondation Soins Lausanne** recherche **de suite ou à convenir** plusieurs : Auxiliaire de santé (H/F)========================== **Taux développer un **lien relationnel** et de **confiance**  * Collaborer activement aux activités des équipes interdisciplinaires avec un **rôle propre** vous permettant de **valoriser votre métier conditions de travail et de rémunération équitables  * Des conditions de prévoyance professionnelle qui s’étendent au\-delà des prestations minimales prévues par la loi    Les avantages de nous Fair\-ON\-Pay)  * Rémunération selon la Convention Collective de Travail (CCT) du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois  * Offres avantageuses avec tarifs préférentiels dans des sociétés de services autour du sport, santé et bien\-être et loisirs divers  * Politique de mobilité douce et participation aux frais de transports publics  * Cinq semaines de vacances par année et six semaines dès 50 ans   Pour un traitement de qualité de votre candidature, nous vous prions d'adresser un **dossier de candidature complet** **en précisant le taux d'activité souhaité** via Jobup jusqu'au **1 décembre
